evidence: Mica Mine Tops Route is started from the Historic Haast to Paringa Cattle Track.
The turn off to Mica Mine Tops Route is signposted around 2 hours after Blowfly Hut on the Historic Haast to Paringa Cattle Track.
The Mica Mine Tops Route leaves the main Cattle Track and zig zags through 23 corners up to 960 m high.
On a clear day, there are excellent views from mountains to sea as the route follows the dips and hollows of the range to Mataketake Hut.

not_on_route.name: Māori Saddle Route
not_on_route.quote: We recommend going up to the hut via the Māori Saddle Route.

doubts: The start is the signposted turn off on the Historic Haast to Paringa Cattle Track about 2 hours after Blowfly Hut. The turn off has no feature or entry, so the start is the Cattle Track walk (L1). DOC's time '8 hr from SH6' covers the approach from SH6, which passes Blowfly Hut on the Cattle Track before the turn off, so Blowfly Hut is listed in huts; the page does not say the way passes it itself. The text does not say whether one returns the same way, so the shape is one_way, ending at Mataketake Hut. The page says Mataketake Hut can be reached via Mica Mine Route; it is not clear whether that is this route, so it is not recorded. Māori Saddle Route is the recommended way up to the hut and is not described as its own way on this page.
